ask.title: Ask
ask.lead: Ask how to do something, or describe a problem. We'll find the answer in the user guide and known issues.
ask.placeholder: e.g. How do I add subtitles?
ask.answer.none: Couldn't find anything relevant. Try different words, or ask in the community (KakaoTalk / Discord). If it looks like a new bug, report it via Feedback and we'll relay it to Apple.
